title: Northern India Expedition Overview
summary: Get ready for an unforgettable journey through Northern India starting with Jalandhar, Amritsar, Kasol, and Manali!
content:
• Train journey from your city to Jalandhar.
• Explore the cultural richness at Wagah Border.
• Visit the serene Golden Temple in Amritsar.
• Relaxing riverside camping in Kasol & explore vibrant Kasol markets.
• Visit Manikaran Gurudwara & trek to Chalal village.
• Bijli Mahadev Trek: Breathtaking views, green meadows & dense forests.
• Manali sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Jogini Waterfall & Vashisht Hot Springs.
• Solang Valley landscapes & Atal Tunnel traversal.
• Explore Sissu village nestled in Lahaul-Spiti valley.
• Kullu river rafting adventure.
• Conclude with a scenic drive back to Jalandhar.

Note: Only people aged 12 to 35 years are allowed to join this trip as it is a complete backpacking itinerary.

title: What Will Be the Group Size for This Himachal Tour?
content: We like to keep our groups small, with just 40 to 50 people. This way, everyone can get to know each other better and work together more easily. Smaller groups make it easier to coordinate the trip and have a more collaborative experience. It's simpler to bond with everyone when there aren't too many people around.
